🎬 Ghosts (UK) (2019–2023)

Ghosts follows Alison and Mike Cooper, a young married couple whose lives take an unexpected turn when they inherit Button House, a beautiful but crumbling English country mansion. Excited by the possibility of transforming the property into a successful hotel, the couple soon discovers that their new home is occupied by an unusual collection of ghosts from different periods of British history. From a dramatic Georgian noblewoman and a strict military officer to a prehistoric caveman, a medieval plague victim, and a disgraced politician, each spirit brings a completely different personality and endless opportunities for hilarious misunderstandings. After a near-fatal accident leaves Alison able to see and communicate with the ghosts, her ordinary life becomes increasingly complicated as the supernatural residents demand attention, argue among themselves, and interfere with the couple’s renovation plans. Meanwhile, Mike struggles to understand the strange situations unfolding around him because he cannot see the spirits himself. As Alison gradually develops friendships with the ghosts, she begins discovering their fascinating histories, unfinished business, and surprisingly emotional personal stories. Despite their constant disagreements and chaotic behavior, the unusual household slowly becomes an unexpected family. Combining clever British humor, charming supernatural situations, memorable characters, and heartfelt storytelling, Ghosts explores friendship, love, acceptance, family, history, and the importance of finding belonging in the most unexpected places.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Fantasy • Supernatural Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 8.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 30 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Creators: Mathew Baynton, Simon Farnaby, Martha Howe-Douglas, Jim Howick, Laurence Rickard & Ben Willbond
